assetReusePolicy: No site image, logo, font, photograph, template, or UI-kit binary is copied without explicit use rights and authorized access.

items.title: Brand World UI kit
items.notes: Official resource link resolves to AB InBev SharePoint; exact files and usage permissions have not been inspected.

items.title: AB InBev symbol + wordmark
items.notes: Use an authorized original artwork file. Approved gold/black/white versions, equal clear space based on symbol, favored top-left or footer sign-off. Never redraw, distort or recolor.

items.title: AB InBev symbol and shorthand
items.notes: Only sanctioned symbol artwork. Do not treat a screenshot as the master logo.

items.title: Expressive symbol variations
items.notes: Expressive reworks of the symbol are explicitly restricted to special approval; reject by default.

items.title: Corporate tagline treatment
items.notes: Tagline often used under logo or as sign-off. Check exact approved lockup.

items.title: Avantt corporate typography
items.notes: Primary AB InBev typeface. Verify installed license and legal font embedding separately for every medium.

items.title: Ideal stack, headline graphic devices and text/color
items.notes: Use clear hierarchy; at most one emphasized graphic device per headline; ensure contrast.

items.title: Core, secondary, tertiary palette and accessibility
items.notes: Machine-readable values in brand/brand.json; tertiary colors mostly limited to chart/data encodings.

items.title: Cheers gold gradient
items.notes: Core brand visual; no guessed exact gradient stop positions. Use approved image/vector or confirmed gradient specifications.

items.title: Dynamic symbol-derived curve compositions
items.notes: Graphic compositions are based on enlarged curves of ABI symbol; do not trace protected site examples as distributable masters.

items.title: Pattern and texture treatment
items.notes: Use patterns sparingly and mainly where text density is low.

items.title: Lifestyle / togetherness / golden moments
items.notes: Premium, optimistic celebratory interactions; select image only when meaningful to message.

items.title: Behind-the-scenes / process / brewing
items.notes: Close details showcasing process and craft; avoid generic unlicensed stock substitutions.

items.title: Sustainability / people / environment
items.notes: Environmental and social commitment story, based on factual initiatives.

items.title: High-contrast monochrome and gold colorized images
items.notes: Official reference mentions high-contrast monochrome and multiply/gold-gradient coloring. Obtain rights for source photography.

items.title: Official brand application examples
items.notes: Inspiration/QA references only. Actual images are not copied into repo.

items.title: Approved internal corporate PPT template
items.notes: User will provide. Extract slide masters, logo artwork, dimensions, typography and layout conventions after receipt.

items.title: User-supplied Sustainability / CEA / BrewHub PPT reference
items.notes: Supplied 24-slide deck with 49 layout definitions. Anonymized design metadata: brand/references/sustainability-cea-brewhub-2026/design-analysis.json. Not confirmed as company-wide official master template.
